summary: Brookfield Infrastructure Partners L.P. filed a Form 6-K attaching two exhibits: the Twelfth Amendment to the limited partnership agreement of Brookfield Infrastructure L.P., and a Guarantee Indenture dated August 27, 2026. The amendment creates a new series of Class A Preferred Limited Partnership Units, revises tax allocation provisions, and deletes a requirement to furnish Schedule K-1s. The indenture establishes guarantees among the entities. These are routine governance and financing documents, not a special-situation event. No acquisition, divestiture, tender, restructuring, or other categorized action is present.
